newsitem.title: CANADA: Maple Leaf to buy Burns' meat operations.
newsitem.headline: Maple Leaf to buy Burns' meat operations.

text.p: Maple Leaf Foods Inc said on Monday that it will buy the fresh pork and prepared meat operations of Burns Foods for an undisclosed sum.
"Maple Leaf Foods will finance the acquisition comfortably out of its existing financial resources as part of its annual investment and divestiture plan," it said.
The acquisition included Burns' animal slaughter plants and processing plants in Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta. Maple Leaf has said it intends to invest in its core business.
Maple Leaf Foods is Canada's largest food processor.
